feat.name: Sin of Pride

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Pride, carrying within you the power and arrogance of Lucifer. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, an imposing presence, and the ability to reject any outcome that would place you beneath another.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Pride
entries: You embody superiority and perfection. You have Advantage on Intimidation checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Lucifer
entries: Your mind is unyielding, and your ego refuses to be broken. You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

entries.name: That's Your Flaw
entries: When you take damage, are hit by an attack, or fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reject that outcome. You can use this feature to protect yourself from damage or an attack. You take half damage that triggered this feature.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: You take no damage and suffer no other effects from the attack or damage that triggered this feature.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: You can now use That's Your Flaw when you fail a saving throw. You instead succeed on that saving throw, suffering no effects that would occur as a result of failing it.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: When you use That's Your Flaw to negate an attack or the effects of a failed saving throw, you can cause the effect to be reflected back upon its source.

If you reflect an attack, the attack is resolved against its original attacker, using the same attack roll and comparing it against the attacker's AC. The attacker can still make any saving throw normally allowed by the attack.
If you reflect the effects of a failed saving throw, the creature that caused the saving throw must instead suffer the effects of that failed save.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: When you reflect an attack using That's Your Flaw, you can choose one of the following effects:

items: The reflected attack automatically hits and becomes a Critical Hit.
The target automatically fails any saving throw caused by the reflected attack.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: You regain the use of That's Your Flaw when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the end of each of your turns, if you have no uses of your That's Your Flaw remaining and you did at least one of the following during that turn, roll 1d6:

items: Made an Attack Roll against an enemy.
Forced an enemy to make a Saving Throw.
Took damage from an enemy since the end of your previous turn.

entries: On a roll of 6, you regain one use of your That's Your Flaw.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: After you use That's Your Flaw, you gain the benefits of a Short Rest, except that That's Your Flaw can't be recharged this way. You also gain resistance to all damage until the end of your next turn.
Additionally, The reflected attack deals the maximum damage instead of rolling its damage dice.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: When you die, you can use That's Your Flaw to reject your death. You return to life with Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum, and you suffer no negative effects from dying. The creature that caused your death takes Psychic damage equal to the total damage you took during the current turn.
You can use That's Your Flaw even if you are unconscious or otherwise unable to take actions or reactions.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: After you use That's Your Flaw, you gain the benefits of a Long Rest, except that That's Your Flaw can't be recharged this way. Until the end of your next turn, you are Immune to all damage and Conditions, and nothing can cause you to die.
Additionally, all creatures within 120 feet of you become Frightened for 1 minute, ignoring Immunity to the Frightened condition.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Sin Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

feat.name: Sin of Greed

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Greed, carrying within you the boundless avarice and insatiable hunger of Mammon. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, a covetous presence, and the power to claim that which you desire as your own.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Greed
entries: You embody insatiable desire and avarice, driven to possess anything of value. You have Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Mammon
entries: Your desire to possess and control manifests as an unyielding force. You have Resistance to Force damage.

entries.name: Now Is Mine
entries: When a creature you can see casts a spell, you can use your Reaction to prepare that spell. You retain the prepared spell until you finish a Long Rest.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: The creature that cast the triggering spell must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the spell has no effect, and the creature regains the Spell Slot expended to cast it.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: The target automatically fails the saving throw, and the creature doesn't regain the Spell Slot expended to cast it.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: The triggering effect no longer needs to be a spell. You can steal any spell or feature of a creature you can see, causing the spell or feature to have no effect. The creature doesn't regain any resource expended to use the stolen spell or feature.

After you steal a spell or feature, you gain the benefits of the stolen spell or feature. If the stolen effect is a spell or an activated feature, you can use it once without expending any resources. You retain the stolen spell or feature until you steal another spell or feature, and it doesn't disappear when you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: The number of spells or features you can steal and retain at the same time increases by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus. You can replace any spell or feature you currently retain whenever you steal a new spell or feature.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: You regain the use of Now Is Mine when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the end of each of your turns, if you have no uses of your Now Is Mine remaining and you did at least one of the following during that turn, roll 1d6:

items: Made an Attack Roll against an enemy.
Forced an enemy to make a Saving Throw.
Took damage from an enemy since the end of your previous turn.

entries: On a roll of 6, you regain one use of your Now Is Mine.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: After you steal a spell or feature, the creature that cast the spell or used the feature can't use that spell or feature again until it finishes a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: You can target the corpse of a creature or the soul of a creature if its soul still exists to steal one spell or feature that creature possessed. You gain the benefits of the stolen spell or feature as though you had stolen it using Now Is Mine.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: There is no limit to the number of spells or activated features you can retain at the same time.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Sin Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

feat.name: Sin of Lust

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Lust, carrying within you the irresistible temptation and overwhelming desire of Asmodeus. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, an enchanting presence, and the power to awaken absolute devotion in the hearts of others.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Lust
entries: You embody irresistible beauty and desire, causing others to become drawn toward you. You have Advantage on Persuasion checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Asmodeus
entries: Your voice carries the irresistible temptation of Asmodeus, and your body has adapted to withstand the power of sound itself. You have Resistance to Thunder damage.

entries.name: Look At Me
entries: As an Action, choose one creature you can see within range.
The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Charmed condition for 1 hour.
While affected, the creature regards you as a trusted companion, speaks to you in a friendly manner and am happy to accommodate your small requests.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: The duration increases to 8 hours.
The creature regards you as one of its closest companions and deeply trusts you. It willingly accepts requests that don't directly harm itself or violate its core beliefs.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: The duration increases to 1 day.
The creature considers you one of the most important people in its life and refuses to knowingly harm you.
It willingly accepts requests that cause it personal inconvenience or minor losses.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: The duration increases to 7 days.
The creature becomes devoted to you. It willingly places itself in danger to protect you and accepts requests involving reasonable personal risk.
If another creature threatens you, it instinctively attempts to defend you before considering its own safety.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: The duration increases to 1 month.
The creature's affection becomes obsession.
It can no longer willingly act against your interests and accepts requests that provide no benefit to itself or require great personal sacrifice.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: The duration increases to 1 year.
You regain the use of Look At Me when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the end of each of your turns, if you have no uses of your Look At Me remaining and you did at least one of the following during that turn, roll 1d6:

items: Made an Attack Roll against an enemy.
Forced an enemy to make a Saving Throw.
Took damage from an enemy since the end of your previous turn.

entries: On a roll of 6, you regain one use of your Look At Me.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: The duration increases to 10 years.
You become the most important person in the creature's life.
It is willing to risk its life, betray allies, abandon loyalties, reject its beliefs, and sacrifice treasured possessions if doing so benefits you.

Additionally, if the creature is immune to being Charmed or immune to magical effects that influence the mind, it must still make the Charisma saving throw against Look At Me normally. On a failed save, this feature ignores that immunity.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: The duration increases to 100 years.
The creature's devotion becomes absolute.
It willingly sacrifices its life, soul, memories, or anything else it possesses if you command it to do so.
Additionally, A creature targeted by Look At Me automatically fails saving throws against this feature.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: The duration becomes permanent.
Look At Me no longer charms or magically compels its target.
Instead, it permanently rewrites the creature's desires, emotions, and loyalties.
The creature genuinely believes that its devotion toward you is its own free will, and this effect isn't considered being Charmed, magically compelled, or under mind control.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Sin Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

feat.name: Sin of Sloth

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Sloth, carrying within you the endless stagnation and lethargy of Belphegor. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, an oppressive stillness, and the power to accumulate destructive force by refusing to act.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Sloth
entries: You embody stillness and unnatural patience, allowing you to endure while others exhaust themselves. You have Advantage on Stealth checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Belphegor
entries: Your body remains unnaturally still even as destructive energy gathers within you. You have Resistance to Lightning damage.

entries.name: Far Too Late
entries: As a Bonus Action, you begin accumulating destructive energy within yourself. The first time you use this feature, you gain one Inertia Die.
At the start of each of your turns, the current Inertia Die remains until you use a Bonus Action to increase it. You can use a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to gain the next Inertia Die.
Whenever you use a Bonus Action to increase your Inertia Die, you gain the additional benefits granted by your current level until the start of your next turn.

You can release the accumulated energy whenever you deal damage to a creature with an attack or other effect. When you do so, you add all accumulated dice to the damage dealt. The damage dealt by the accumulated dice is the same damage type as the damage that triggered the release.
You can release the accumulated energy even if you have not reached the maximum number of Inertia Dice.
Once you release the accumulated energy, you can't use Far Too Late again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: As the power within you begins to settle, your body becomes harder to disturb. Whenever you use a Bonus Action to increase your Inertia Die, your AC increases by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn.
Your Inertia Die becomes a d6 starting on your second turn.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: The longer you remain still, the more your body absorbs the force that would otherwise break it. Whenever you use a Bonus Action to increase your Inertia Die, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your primary ability modifier.
Your Inertia Die becomes a d8 starting on your third turn.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your stillness begins to reject the violence of the world itself. Whenever you use a Bonus Action to increase your Inertia Die, you have Advantage on Saving Throws until the start of your next turn, and the first Attack Roll made against you before then has Disadvantage.
Your Inertia Die becomes a d10 starting on your fourth turn.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: The force you refuse to release begins sustaining your body, turning patience into unnatural recovery. Whenever you use a Bonus Action to increase your Inertia Die, you regain Hit Points equal to one roll of your current Inertia Die plus your Constitution modifier. This does not expend the Inertia Die.
Your Inertia Die becomes a d12 starting on your fifth turn.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your accumulated power no longer requires uninterrupted rest to return. You regain the use of Far Too Late when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the end of each of your turns, if you have no uses of your Far Too Late remaining and you did at least one of the following during that turn, roll 1d6:

items: Made an Attack Roll against an enemy.
Forced an enemy to make a Saving Throw.
Took damage from an enemy since the end of your previous turn.

entries: On a roll of 6, you regain one use of your Far Too Late.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: Your stillness reaches an unnatural perfection, causing both body and mind to resist the world around you. Whenever you use a Bonus Action to increase your Inertia Die, you gain Resistance to all damage and Immunity to all Conditions until the start of your next turn.
You can continue accumulating energy beyond the sixth Inertia Die.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: The force you have accumulated becomes too great to vanish with your death. If you die while Far Too Late is active, the energy within you erupts violently.
Each creature within 30 feet of you must make a Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 66d6 Force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
After this eruption occurs, Far Too Late ends.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: At the height of your power, even restraint becomes terrifying. The longer you refuse to act, the more catastrophic the force you accumulate becomes. Starting on your sixth turn, your Inertia Die becomes a d100.
After the sixth Inertia Die, each additional Inertia Die is a d100.
You can continue accumulating energy without being limited by the normal maximum number of Inertia Dice.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Sin Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

feat.name: Sin of Envy

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Envy, carrying within you the spiteful desire to drag those above you down to your level. This manifestation grants you the power to strip away advantages, suppress extraordinary abilities, and reduce even the mightiest foes to something ordinary.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Envy
entries: You are skilled at concealing your resentment behind false admiration and carefully chosen words. You have Advantage on Deception checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Leviathan
entries: Your body carries the bitter cold of envy, a presence that chills even those who stand above you. You have Resistance to Cold damage.

entries.name: Drag Them Down
entries: You focus your envy upon a single creature, seeking to strip away everything that makes it superior.

As an Action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The creature becomes the target of your Envious Mark. This effect requires Concentration, as if you were concentrating on a spell, and lasts for up to 1 minute.
While you maintain Concentration on Envious Mark, the target is subject to the effects granted by your current level.
If your Concentration ends, Envious Mark ends immediately, and all effects caused by Envious Mark end.

entries.name: Level 1
entries: Your envy begins by stripping away the foundations that allow others to endure. While a creature is affected by your Envious Mark, its AC is reduced by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Whenever the target regains Hit Points, it regains only half the normal amount. Any Regeneration the target possesses is reduced by half.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your envy strips away what others have given the target. All temporary Hit Points the target currently has are removed, and the target can't gain Temporary Hit Points while affected by your Envious Mark.
The target can't regain Hit Points or benefit from Regeneration.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: Your envy begins to tear away the strengths that make the target formidable. The target takes a penalty to its Attack Rolls equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
The target's Speed is halved.
The target loses Darkvision.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: You refuse to allow the target any advantage that places it above you. Advantage on Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Saving Throws is negated, causing those rolls to be made normally.
The target loses all Resistance.
The target loses Blindsight.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: You begin stripping away the gifts that make the target exceptional. Each of the target's Ability Scores is reduced by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
The effects of the target's Magic Items are suppressed while it remains affected by your Envious Mark.
The target loses Tremorsense.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your accumulated power no longer requires uninterrupted rest to return. You regain the use of Drag Them Down when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the end of each of your turns, if you have no uses of your Drag Them Down remaining and you did at least one of the following during that turn, roll 1d6:

items: Made an Attack Roll against an enemy.
Forced an enemy to make a Saving Throw.
Took damage from an enemy since the end of your previous turn.

entries: On a roll of 6, you regain one use of your Drag Them Down.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: You strip away the traits that make the target something greater than ordinary. The target loses all Immunities to damage and Conditions.
The target loses its ability to Fly, Swim, or Climb unless those movement modes are provided by its normal walking speed.
The target loses all Passive Traits.
The target loses Truesight.
All of the target's Senses are reduced to normal sight.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: There is nothing left for your envy to take, so you begin dragging the target itself into decline.
At the end of each of the target's turns, it gains 1 level of Exhaustion.
The target can't speak or communicate telepathically while affected by your Envious Mark.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: At the height of your envy, nothing about the target is allowed to remain beyond your reach. The target loses all Traits.
The target can't use Mythic Actions, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Regional Effects, or Multiattack.
The effects of the target's passive and activated Features are suppressed while it remains affected by your Envious Mark.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your envy becomes absolute. Your Envious Mark cannot be countered, interrupted, dispelled, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

feat.name: Sin of Gluttony

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Gluttony, carrying within you an insatiable hunger that consumes not only flesh, but the very essence of those you devour.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Gluttony
entries: Your insatiable hunger allows you to endure what would overwhelm others. You have Advantage on Survival checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Beelzebub
entries: Your body has become resistant to the corrosive nature of your endless hunger. You have Resistance to Acid damage.

entries.name: Feed The Void
entries: You can consume the remains of a creature that has been reduced to 0 Hit Points or has died within the last 24 hours.
When you Devour a creature, you gain Devour Points equal to its Challenge Rating. If it has no Challenge Rating, you instead gain Devour Points equal to its Level.

You can gain Devour Points from a specific creature stat block only once. Once you have gained Devour Points from a creature using a particular stat block, consuming another creature that uses the same stat block provides no additional Devour Points.
Your accumulated Devour Points can be spent to permanently enhance your body and abilities. Unless otherwise stated, spent Devour Points are lost.
You unlock additional ways to spend your Devour Points as you gain levels in this feat. You can only use the options unlocked at your current level or lower.

entries.name: Level 1
entries: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against Disease.
1 Devour Point → Regain Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against the Poisoned condition.
2 Devour Points → Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: You have Resistance to Poison damage.
3 Devour Points → Increase your Hit Point Maximum by 1, up to a maximum of your Level × 10.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: You are Immune to Disease.
5 Devour Points → Increase your AC by 1. This bonus is Natural Armor and can increase your AC by up to your Proficiency Bonus + your Primary Ability Modifier.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.
10 Devour Points → Increase one Ability Score by 1. There is no maximum total increase, but each Ability Score can be increased by no more than your Proficiency Bonus × 2.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your accumulated power no longer requires uninterrupted rest to return. You regain the use of Feed The Void when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the end of each of your turns, if you have no uses of your Feed The Void remaining and you did at least one of the following during that turn, roll 1d6:

items: Made an Attack Roll against an enemy.
Forced an enemy to make a Saving Throw.
Took damage from an enemy since the end of your previous turn.

entries: On a roll of 6, you regain one use of your Feed The Void.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: You are Immune to Poison damage and the Poisoned condition.
15 Devour Points → Gain one Damage Resistance.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: You automatically succeed on all Death Saving Throws.
25 Devour Points → Gain one Condition Immunity.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: Your hunger has become limitless. Whenever you Devour a creature, you gain Devour Points equal to twice its Challenge Rating. If it has no Challenge Rating, you instead gain Devour Points equal to twice its Level.
100 Devour Points → Gain one Damage Immunity.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Sin Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

feat.name: Sin of Wrath

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Wrath, carrying within you the boundless fury of Satan. This manifestation grants you overwhelming physical power, relentless speed, and the ability to unleash your anger without limit.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Wrath
entries: Your fury manifests through overwhelming physical force. You have Advantage on Athletics checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Satan
entries: Your rage burns with an infernal fire that cannot be extinguished. You have Resistance to Fire damage.

entries.name: Burn It All
entries: As a Bonus Action, you unleash your Wrath, entering Wrath Form for 1 minute.
While in Wrath Form, whenever a creature hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to make an Attack or cast a spell that requires an Attack Roll against that creature.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: While in Wrath Form, you are Immune to the Frightened and Charmed conditions, and your Speed is doubled.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: While in Wrath Form, you have Advantage on Attack Rolls, and your Attack Rolls score a Critical Hit on a roll of 6

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your attacks ignore Resistance. If a creature is Immune to the damage dealt by your attack, it instead takes damage as though it had Resistance.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: While in Wrath Form, you gain one additional Action on each of your turns, and your Attack Rolls score a Critical Hit on a roll of 13

entries.name: Level 11
entries: You regain the use of Burn It All when you finish a Long Rest.
Additionally, at the end of each of your turns, if you have no uses of your Burn It All remaining and you did at least one of the following during that turn, roll 1d6:

items: Made an Attack Roll against an enemy.
Forced an enemy to make a Saving Throw.
Took damage from an enemy since the end of your previous turn.

entries: On a roll of 6, you regain one use of your Burn It All.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: Your attacks ignore Immunity.
Your attacks made as a reaction to being hit are always Critical Hits

entries.name: Level 15
entries: Your attacks made as a reaction to being hit no longer require a Reaction.
Whenever one of these attacks deals damage, you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: While in Wrath Form, nothing can end or suppress your Wrath Form before its duration expires.
Your attacks made as a reaction to being hit deal twice the normal damage of a Critical Hit.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Sin Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

feat.name: Aura Imbuement
entries: You can use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of weapons. When you use Charisma in this way, add your Proficiency Bonus to the weapon's base damage.

feat.name: Mana Imbuement
entries: You can use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of weapons. When you use Intelligence in this way, add your Proficiency Bonus to the weapon's base damage.

feat.name: Faith Imbuement
entries: You can use Wisdom instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of weapons. When you use Wisdom in this way, add your Proficiency Bonus to the weapon's base damage.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Soul Vessel
entries: Your body becomes a vessel capable of containing more than one Sin or Grace Feat. You can choose one additional Sin or Grace Feat.
When choosing a Sin or Grace Feat, you ignore the prerequisite "You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat".

However, carrying multiple sources of immense power places tremendous strain on your body. For each Sin or Grace Feat you possess beyond the first, your Constitution score is permanently reduced by 2.

optionalfeature.name: Improved Pact of the Soul Vessel
entries: You can choose one additional Sin or Grace Feat.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different Sin or Grace Feat.
